C0704.title: UK Couple Sentenced for £9M Automated Ticket Scalping Fraud
C0704.summary: A UK Court of Appeal summary states that Peter Hunter and David Smith were ticket touts who used sophisticated software, some purchased on the dark web, to bulk-buy tickets for popular sporting, music, and cultural events and resell them at substantial premiums on secondary ticketing websites. They were convicted of offences connected with running a fraudulent ticket resale business, and the Court of Appeal upheld the core convictions in 2021. The case illustrates how automated ticket purchasing and false-identity bulk buying can undermine ordinary consumers' access to tickets.
